method: AI-assisted visual boundary review of four purposively stratified vocabulary pages against rendered facsimile; no independent human verification

pages.rationale: first vocabulary page; heading, carry-over material and column transitions
dense early A-section with multiline entries and a page-turn continuation
middle C-section with dense two-column lexicographic layout
late V-section near the end of the alphabetical vocabulary

sampleDesign.caveat: Purposive diagnostic sample, not a probability sample; metrics must not be interpreted as confidence-bounded estimates for the complete vocabulary.

interpretation: Precision is high in the diagnostic sample: most proposed starts correspond to visible article starts.
Recall is lower because the conservative indentation heuristic systematically misses some starts, especially at page tops/bottoms and when OCR merges several articles into one candidate.
Page 133 is the weakest sampled stratum because section-opening/header material and multiple merged lines generate both false starts and missed starts.
The candidate layer is suitable for triage and review acceleration, not for direct publication as a lexicon.
